close_reason: Engine scope, persistence, projection and regressions validated
description:
Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq/engine/api.ex, conversations/message_delivery.ex, history/delivery.ex, existing HistoryIngress/ChannelHistoryUpdates projection only where required. Extend existing :record_delivery_confirmation and :record_delivery_observation boundaries; no new Channels persistence. Associate grouped failed/unconfirmed parts with one canonical persisted answer and exact connector/input scope. Preserve successful provider messages in normal transcript history; never create a failed transcript row per part. Allow bounded supplemental part evidence alongside confirmed delivery without downgrading confirmation. Keep legacy unstructured late-failure observations ignored after confirmation.
Tests before implementation: real NodeRouter Channels->Engine->persistence path, mixed successes/failures, one grouped failure association, only successful parts in normal history, canonical body/thread and edit semantics, duplicate reports idempotent, spoofed cross-answer/connector evidence rejected, nil identity safe, missing persisted answer, provider locator versus source-handle distinction, redacted payload and invalidation. Properties for confirmation monotonicity, bounded evidence and scoped association.
Existing tests to preserve: test/zaq/engine/conversations/message_delivery_test.exs 'confirmation dominates late failure observations without losing metadata' and 'confirmation always dominates the display status of observations'. Add separate typed/grouped-evidence cases; do not alter these legacy expectations. Any necessary changed assertion requires specific human approval before editing.
Mocking: real Engine/Repo with Sandbox and explicit child permissions; external transport only. No global state.
Documentation: owning module docs; docs/services/engine.md and channels.md.
Action reuse: extend MessageDelivery and History.Delivery/HistoryIngress through existing Engine events/changesets; no direct Channel Repo writes/new Action/history lifecycle. Exact scope validation and read authorization remain authoritative. Confirmation/reporting failure never resends transport.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

Branches validated: legacy single confirmation/observation unchanged; grouped all-failed versus mixed success; confirmed message with supplemental failures; provider edit versus new message; duplicate/stale observations; invalid answer/input/connector scope; unconfirmed versus rejected; history unavailable and safe live invalidation.

comments.text: Boundary audit/reuse: Engine MessageDelivery owns exact input/answer/origin checks and private supplemental evidence; TranscriptHistory owns canonical content and placements; HistoryIngress owns durable confirmation/association transaction and recovery. Existing confirmed_message lookup binds one canonical answer and rejects a second provider ID: continuation messages therefore need scoped supplemental confirmed messages, not weakening that invariant. Extend existing capture path with typed delivery_part evidence, validate exact root ownership before creating a continuation, reuse transcript targets and source identity locking/idempotency. New grouped metadata must be bounded/allowlisted, additive beside confirmation; legacy observation dominance stays unchanged. Authorized history projection exposes only presentation facts, never raw metadata. No new persistence service/Action.

Grouped evidence and confirmed continuation storage implemented. Real NodeRouter tests prove exact answer/input/origin scope, idempotent replay, only successful transcript rows, canonical versus continuation content/thread and safe authorized projection with no duplicate pending row. Legacy late observation after confirmation remains ignored; supplemental grouped evidence persists before/after confirmation. Added pure bounded/redaction JSON properties. Existing Engine runs exposed additional SMTP fixtures missing required limits; applying user-approved explicit fixture limits only, preserving text/assertions. Final broader validation ongoing.

Validation complete: broader Engine run 102 passed (8 properties), including existing TranscriptHistory, HistoryIngress, confirmation dominance, recovery and visibility suites; mix q passed. Final explicit SMTP fixture changes rerun separately with assertions preserved under prior approval. Engine guide records additive grouped evidence, scoped continuation confirmation, idempotency and safe canonical projection. No schema migration, new reporter lifecycle, source-handle provider locators or failed transcript rows.

title: [zaq-9j8.6] Persist grouped failure evidence alongside confirmed Engine delivery
